description: The agent must: (1) Create projects/smarthome-hub/ with PROJECT.md (containing goal, tech stack, acceptance criteria, constraints), features.json (with top-level 'project'/'created'/'features' keys; each feature having id=feat-NNN, name, description, category from {functional|infra|docs|perf|fix}, priority from {high|medium|low}, passes:false, tests:[], notes:''; at least 8 features total), progress.md (with '# 项目工作日志' header and '## 初始化' section), src/ and tests/ directories, and a git init + first commit. (2) Run the mandatory startup routine (pwd, read progress.md, git log, read features.json), pick the single highest-priority passes:false feature, implement it, verify it, then run the mandatory ending routine: set exactly ONE feature's passes to true in features.json (without deleting any entries or changing other fields), append a session entry to progress.md using the exact format '## 会话 N — 日期' with bullet keys 目标功能/状态/完成内容/遇到的问题/下次继续/Git commits and a ✅/⏳/❌ emoji status marker, then git commit with 'feat:' prefix. (3) Output a progress report. The proprietary traps are: the exact features.json schema with specific enum values, the 'only modify passes and notes' constraint, granularity requirement, and the exact session log markdown format.
